requirements.description: The system clock shall operate at a nominal frequency of 50.0 MHz derived from onboard oscillator via MMCM.
Total peripheral logic (excluding CPU and CNN-MAMBA) shall consume <= 5000 LUTs, <= 3000 FFs, <= 10 BRAM36k.
End-to-end sample acquisition latency from AFE DRDY# to UART transmission start shall be <= 10.0 ms.
The SPI master shall implement SPI Mode 1 (CPOL=0, CPHA=1).
SCLK frequency shall be configurable via register division; default division ratio shall be 25 (2.0 MHz SCLK at 50 MHz sys_clk).
The SPI master shall support autonomous 72-bit burst reading (24b status + 24b CH1 + 24b CH2) upon falling edge of DRDY#.
CS# setup time (tCSSC) prior to the first SCLK edge shall be >= 4 SCLK cycles (2.0 us).
CS# hold time (tSCCS) following the final SCLK edge shall be >= 4 SCLK cycles (2.0 us).
An asynchronous capture FIFO (depth >= 8 words x 24-bit) shall isolate the SPI SCLK domain from the system bus domain.
A Ping-Pong dual-bank BRAM buffer shall hold two alternating frames of 32 samples each (288 bytes per bank).
The buffer controller shall assert BUFFER_HALF_FULL interrupt when Bank A fills, seamlessly switching write ingress to Bank B.
If write ingress attempts to overwrite an unread buffer bank, an OVERFLOW_FAULT status bit shall assert and log dropped sample count.
The UART shall support 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity (8N1).
Baud rate generator shall support standard rates: 115200 (divisor 434 @ 50 MHz) and 921600 (divisor 54 @ 50 MHz).
Standard data packets shall use a 14-byte frame structure: [0xAA][TYPE][TIMESTAMP_32b][CH1_24b][CH2_24b][STATUS_8b][CRC8].
CRC-8 shall be computed over bytes 1 through 12 using polynomial x^8 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x07).
All peripheral register read/write accesses shall adhere to the AMBA 3 APB protocol without generating protocol deadlocks.
Unmapped address reads shall return 0x0000_0000 with PSLVERR = 0.
Back-to-back writes with zero wait states (PREADY = 1) shall complete deterministically in 2 clock cycles.
